notes.title: Major update from June 1, 2021
notes.content:
New gameplay trailer
[previewyoutube=n0Q57eLH-Hc;full][/previewyoutube]
About this update.
-What does this update include?
1. The maps have been completely redesigned.
2. Reworked voice acting.
3. Added subtitles.
4. Redesigned the main menu | menu.
5. Added scenes during which dialogues occur.
6. Now when you start the menu, the game in the background will slow down.
- What is planned in future updates?
1. Translation of the game into English, and if possible into other languages.
We also remind you that your opinion is important to us, we read your discussions, reviews, etc., based on the information received, we try to make the games better!

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
That came in the 1.2 update that was changed\fixed\added:
1. Voice support was added, in Russian and English languages. (Planned still and on Chinese do, but there is no interpreter.)
2. Fixed a slope on 1 map where the car was stuck.
3. All maps have been changed.
4. Added realistic clouds.

notes.title: Update 1.1 improvements.
notes.content:
Update 1.1 improvements:
1. The inscription in the upper left corner was removed.
2. Has been reworked some maps(At a now higher FPS)
3. There have been attempts to do voice tracking, but due to a malfunction of the microphone, it was decided to add full voice support in the next update.

notes.title: update 1.1
notes.content:
New update 1.1: - add 2 languages: English and Chinese, revised card, the machine of the protagonist and the water:
Adding 2 languages: English and Chinese-2 languages have been added to the game, but so far only in the menu, in the next update, along with the return of voice support in Russian, voice support in English and Chinese will be added.
The main character's car-the car has become more realistic, and new features have been added.
Water - now you can see when the water collides with any object (except the main character's car) , objects with physical properties do not sink and float with the flow.
Reworked maps-the update was done from scratch, so the maps that are at the moment, are different from those that were before.
At the moment there is no voice support in the game, but it will be added in the next update.
Also in the next update will be removed the red inscription in the left-top corner.
The game will be updated until you update the 2.0(the 2.0 update written in the first post: RECENT UPDATES).
